svg.title: Sauna Club Membership Card (10 per A4 sheet)
svg.desc: Editable template by DIVELUX, https://diveluxsaunahat.com. CC BY 4.0. Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque and Inter (Google Fonts, SIL OFL 1.1). Text layers are live text; groups are named after the fields.
svg.text: · Back sheet. Print on the back of the front sheet, flip on the long edge.
